title: Two recordings of one night
description: Line up audio from two devices with your own notes, without passing a guess about the source of a sound off as a fact.

blocks.text: The phone records a partner or an animal, and the app credits the sound to the owner. That is a direct complaint about identifying the source. An extra recording from a second phone is only a hypothesis of a solution.

quote.text: If I sleep alone this app is accurate. Otherwise, all it does is record my wife’s snoring and what she does. It’s literally 80% her, all I do is roll over once or twice and breathe heavy. It cannot distinguish between people. Move onto another app.

blocks.text: First test whether lining up two tracks helps people make sense of specific episodes. Keep the times and their own notes, without assigning a source automatically.

Two devices make the setup harder and still don’t guarantee that people can be told apart. If the participants can’t line the recordings up with any confidence, the idea doesn’t deliver the value claimed for it. Until it has been tested that way, it is early to build a separate product.
